description: This is a unit test source file for trigger noise filtering algorithms in an engine control system, testing how the trigger decoder handles noiseless and noisy signals for a 60-2 wheel tachometer configuration.

classes.name: EngineTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods for engine trigger testing simulations, such as firing trigger edges and moving time forward.

methods.name: void fireEvent(EngineTestHelper * eth,bool isRise)
methods.description: Simulates a trigger edge event (rise or fall) in the engine test helper, firing different events based on configuration.
parameters: isRise - boolean indicating if the trigger edge is rising

methods.name: void noisyPulse(EngineTestHelper * eth,int idx,int durationUs,bool isRise,int noiseIdx,int durationNoiseUs,int offsetNoiseUs,int numSpikes)
methods.description: Creates a pulse with optional noise spikes, simulating real-world noisy sensor signals during trigger testing.
parameters: durationUs - duration of the pulse in microseconds

methods.name: void fireNoisyCycle60_2(EngineTestHelper * eth,int numCycles,int durationUs,int noiseIdx,int durationNoiseUs,int offsetNoiseUs,int numSpikes)
methods.description: Performs multiple cycles of noisy pulses for a 60-2 wheel signal pattern, used to test trigger decoder robustness.

methods.name: void resetTrigger(EngineTestHelper & eth)
methods.description: Resets the trigger state to prepare for a new test sequence.

methods.description: Runs a test procedure on the trigger decoder to evaluate its noise filtering performance under various noise conditions.
